name: refusal_projection
description: Refusal-direction projection for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: removes one direction per layer (layers 8-33) from the residual stream, so the model declines far fewer requests. This removes a safety behaviour; you are responsible for what the model writes with it on. It also shifts predictions slightly on ordinary text. Off by default.
direction: per-layer unit direction, refusal vs compliance, measured at prompt level (320 harmful / 320 harmless prompts, 7 assistant-header positions) on Qwen3.8-Flash-Next activations
provenance: https://github.com/sergqwer/Strata-pr (commit 841f8c9), data/experimental-speed-projection; fp32 direction bytes unchanged, renamed for QEngine
credit: Strata by Niko1221 (https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata) and its fork by sergqwer (https://github.com/sergqwer/Strata-pr, MIT), which published this vector
license: Qwen Community License 1.0 (derived from the model's activations)

compatibility.note: measured on another quantization of the same model; not valid for Qwen3.8-27B

effects.side_effects: slight shift of predictions on ordinary text
